Container.Name: Narratarr
Container.Overview: An *arr-style audiobook (and ebook) manager with its own player and reader. Find books on LibriVox, Old-Time Radio, your Prowlarr or Torznab indexers, or the Audible catalog; download them through Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, TorBox, Premiumize, qBittorrent, Transmission, Deluge, SABnzbd or NZBGet; and they're filed as Author/Title with the cover, the way Audiobookshelf expects. Point Audiobookshelf at the same Audiobooks share and Narratarr can ask it to rescan after every download.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The port Narratarr's web page is on.

Config.Name: Audiobooks
Config.Description: Where finished books go, as Author/Title. Give Audiobookshelf this same share.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Optional. Only if you use qBittorrent, Transmission, Deluge, SABnzbd or NZBGet: the share they download to, so Narratarr can pick finished books up (put it on the same disk as Audiobooks and torrents are hard-linked, so they keep seeding). In Settings, map your client's path to /downloads.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user files are written as (99 is Unraid's 'nobody').

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group files are written as (100 is Unraid's 'users').
